We deleted our roadmap page last Tuesday.

Not archived. Deleted. The one with the swimlanes and the four colours that meant nothing to anyone outside product.

Sales asked for it back within an hour. Not because they used it. Because a customer had a screenshot.

We sent the customer the three things we are actually building this quarter, in a text message, with dates.

She replied "finally."

The roadmap page had 1,200 views a month. I now believe most of them were people trying to figure out what the colours meant.
